This section takes effect in daily work immediately upon issue and is to be followed during companion care coordination.

Companion Animal Travel Desk Passenger Travel Operations Policy: The purpose of this section is to keep the journey planning smooth for travelers and their companions from booking through pickup. The Companion Animal Travel Desk coordinates with skyport services so a traveler’s itinerary is supported end to end, with clear records and calm handoffs at each touchpoint. For boarding, the check-in team uses FM-597 to confirm the companion’s travel readiness.

All travel requests start with the desk receiving the companion details tied to the traveler’s booking, then validating that the care arrangements are consistent with skyport procedures. The senior coordinator documents the itinerary status in the active case file, confirms the required attention level for the companion, and schedules desk follow-ups to avoid last-minute changes. When the day of travel arrives, the desk ensures the handover plan is ready for pickup, including gate-area guidance for the traveler and a short briefing on what the companion needs at the point of transfer.

If a traveler contacts the desk with an update, the desk records the change promptly and aligns it with the skyport handling notes, ensuring the updated plan is available for the staff who meet the traveler on arrival. For example, when Rafael Clark travels with Cali, or when Sofia Haddad travels with a companion, the desk verifies that the case file matches the traveler’s identification and that the care steps are staged for the crew at pickup.

Staff must keep communication warm and neutral, treat every companion with steady routines, and use only the established case file as the source of truth. If anything looks inconsistent, the desk escalates to the station supervisor before boarding begins so the traveler experiences a single, coordinated plan.

For operational questions, contact the desk lead at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
